output.summary: A small palm endemic to the highlands of southern Brazil. Its flower-bearing woody sheath is densely covered with distinctive rust-coloured woolly hairs, and its leaves arch back toward the trunk. Locally, the fruit pulp is used to make beverages, wine, juice, jellies and jams.
